Theorem 1 (Chapter 130)

Subject: parametric complexity | ID: 2105

Statement

Let H be a metric space. Every holomorphic operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 3. By the measurable spectral theorem, we decompose \(S_{01300013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the measurable spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the analytic convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
